texts.asr_en: Georgia Tech always moves and always pushes the envelope in technology. Pritchie for Robert Kotaly, it only makes sense to weave in the latest gadgets to police the campus of Georgia Tech. Every time we add something new, everyone has to get trained on it. He's patrolled the 450-acre Atlanta-based university for 15 years. It's been home to several high-profile security events, including a presidential debate. What are the challenges that come with policing a university in the middle of a metropolitan area? At times, the city can have events that actually trigger that we have to know right away. With this new drone capability, with autonomous drone capability, we will get information fast and accurate.
texts.sum_en: Robert Kotaly has been policing the 450-acre campus of Georgia Tech for 15 years. He says the university always pushes the envelope in technology. The drone will provide information fast and accurate, he says.
